P:Traverse the binary search tree with root 4, left 2, right 6, and children 1,3,5,7 using inorder traversal.
M:Visit left subtree, root, then right subtree recursively.
C:1,2,3,4,5,6,7.
V:valid;O(n)
A:[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]

P:Find 7 in [4, 9, 2, 7, 5].
M:Scan values from left to right until the target is found.
C:Indices 0,1,2,3; target found at index 3.
V:valid;O(n)
A:index = 3

P:Find 7 in sorted [1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11].
M:Repeatedly compare the target with the middle value and discard half the search range.
C:Middle values reduce the range until index 3 remains.
V:valid;O(log n)
A:index = 3
